user.title: Marketplace Refresh
user.description: Checks every repository installed from the Marketplace for updates, on the server. The Marketplace itself reads the catalog every 6 hours and only checks custom repositories every 48 hours.

data_description.scan_interval: Hours between two automatic checks. 0 turns the automatic check off: use the button or the action.

abort.marketplace_not_loaded: The Marketplace is not loaded or is disabled.

data_description.scan_interval: Hours between two automatic checks. 0 turns the automatic check off: use the button or the action.

check_updates.name: Check for updates
check_updates.description: Checks every repository installed from the Marketplace for updates. Runs in the background unless wait is set.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait until every repository has been checked before the action ends; the action then fails if the check failed or a repository could not be checked.

check_repository.name: Check a repository for updates
check_repository.description: Checks the repositories behind these Marketplace update entities for updates, and waits for the result.

entity_id.name: Update entities
entity_id.description: Marketplace update entities of the repositories to check.

install_updates.name: Install updates
install_updates.description: Installs the updates of the Marketplace repositories, one after the other, in the background unless wait is set. Administrators only.

entity_id.name: Update entities
entity_id.description: Marketplace update entities to update; leave empty for every repository with an update.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait until every update has been installed before the action ends; the action then fails if an update could not be installed.

marketplace_not_supported.message: This version of the Marketplace is not supported (missing {path}); please open an issue on {issues}.

not_marketplace_update_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a Marketplace update entity.

not_installed.message: {entity_id} is not a repository installed from the Marketplace.

check_cancelled.message: The check was cancelled (Marketplace Refresh was reloaded or removed).

check_while_installing.message: Updates are being installed: check for updates once they are done.

install_cancelled.message: The installs were cancelled (Marketplace Refresh was reloaded or removed).
